text:
maria: Heads-up — we need a small cross-team spec for the token-cost visuals in Console. Specifically: cost per 1K tokens, cache vs batch savings, and routing cost attribution. Who's best to sync on fields?
aj: I can own the cost-side fields. Need definitions for cached vs batched tokens and how runtime reports them.
samir: Runtime can emit three counters per request: total_tokens, kv_cache_hits, batched_tokens. Also can tag model_variant and route_key. Quick proto below.
olivia: UX wants a breakdown card: total cost / 1K, savings % from cache, savings % from batching, and a tooltip linking to query examples. Also need time window options (1h/24h/7d).
dave: We should also expose quota-burn attribution: when routing policy falls back to a cheaper model, console should show which requests were rerouted and the delta.
aj: Agree. For billing alignment we need cost_per_token_microunits on the event. Runtime: can you output that?
samir: Yes, we can emit microcents-per-token (cost_per_token_u) per response. Emitting a short proto payload for each completed response:
```
{
  "request_id": "str",
  "route_key": "str",
  "model_variant": "gptx-8q",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "total_tokens": 432,
  "kv_cache_hits": 128,
  "batched_tokens": 64,
  "cost_per_token_u": 12,   // micro-units (1e-6 of currency)
  "latency_ms": 78
}
```
maria: Nice. UX needs pre-aggregation keys. We should emit route_key, model_variant, region, and a cost_bucket tag (hosted/dedicated/private).
infra-bot: auto-note: telemetry ingestion topic created: prod.token_econ.v1 (partitioned by route_key).
aj: For Console math: cost_per_1k = sum(total_tokens * cost_per_token_u)/sum(total_tokens) * 1000 — but we also need separate lines for raw cost and cost after savings.
olivia: For cache/batch savings compute: naive_cost = total_tokens * cost_per_token_u; retained_cost = (total_tokens - kv_cache_hits - batched_tokens) * cost_per_token_u; savings = naive_cost - retained_cost. Show both absolute and percent.
dave: Edgecase: when batching reduces latency (amortized) but still counts tokens differently across requests. Samir, can you ensure batched_tokens is attributed to the originating requests so we don't double-count?
samir: We'll emit batched_tokens as the number of tokens that were served from a batching window for this request (0 if none). It should be safe to sum across completed responses.
aj: Need telemetry schema PR — I'll draft and tag infra. Also, add a boolean "rerouted" and field "fallback_from" when routing policy redirects to a cheaper variant.
maria: Great. Also flag for "quota_bucket" so per-team quotas can be surfaced.
olivia: UI questions: 1) breakdown card (summary) + 2) expandable per-route table with sparkline and filters by model_variant, region, quota_bucket. 2) Drilldown link to a filtered Events page showing raw telemetry for debugging.
aj: We'll add an aggregated metrics topic for Console to pull 1m and 1h rollups: prod.token_econ.rollup.minute and .hour. Those should include sums of total_tokens, kv_cache_hits, batched_tokens, cost_u.
dave: Who owns rollups? infra-team?
samir: Runtime emits raw events; infra can handle rollups. I'll file a tiny contract doc with the exact field names.
maria: Action items: @aj draft telemetry schema PR by EOD Wed; @infra (samir) confirm rollup keys and add rerouted/fallback fields; @olivia mockup card + table by Fri. I'll coordinate presentation to PMs next week. :thumbsup:
aj: Sounds good. I added a TODO in the repo: github.com/redwood/platform/telemetry/issues/312
olivia: I'll put mocks in Figma and link here when done.
maria: Thanks everyone — moving this to a short sync if needed. :eyes:
